How many customers do we have?: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers FROM customers
Total revenue in 2024: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100)), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND year(o.order_date) = 2024
Revenue by product category: SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100)), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY revenue DESC

SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100)), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY revenue DESC
Top 5 customers by revenue: SELECT c.customer_id, c.full_name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100)), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.full_name ORDER BY revenue DESC, c.customer_id LIMIT 5
Monthly number of completed orders in 20: SELECT month(order_date) AS month, COUNT(*) AS completed_orders FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' AND year(order_date) = 2023 GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
Average order value by channel: SELECT o.channel, ROUND(AVG(t.order_value), 2) AS avg_order_value FROM orders o JOIN (SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity * unit_price * (1 - discount_pct / 100)) AS order_value FROM sales GROUP BY order_id) t ON t.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY o.channel ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC

SELECT o.channel, ROUND(AVG(t.order_value), 2) AS avg_order_value FROM orders o JOIN (SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity * unit_price * (1 - discount_pct / 100)) AS order_value FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id) t ON t.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY o.channel ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC
How many orders were cancelled per year?: SELECT year(order_date) AS year, COUNT(*) AS cancelled_orders FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled' GROUP BY year ORDER BY year
Which 3 products had the most units sold: SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY units_sold DESC, p.product_id LIMIT 3
Number of customers by segment: SELECT segment, COUNT(*) AS customers FROM customers GROUP BY segment ORDER BY customers DESC
Revenue by customer country, top 5: SELECT c.country, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100)), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.country ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5
What share of web sessions converted, by: SELECT device, ROUND(100.0 * AVG(CASE WHEN converted THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 2) AS conversion_rate_pct FROM web_sessions GROUP BY device ORDER BY conversion_rate_pct DESC
Average ticket resolution time in hours: SELECT priority, ROUND(AVG(epoch(resolved_at - opened_at)) / 3600, 2) AS avg_resolution_hours FROM support_tickets WHERE resolved_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY priority ORDER BY avg_resolution_hours
Which suppliers supply the most products: SELECT s.supplier_id, s.supplier_name, COUNT(*) AS products FROM products p JOIN suppliers s ON s.supplier_id = p.supplier_id GROUP BY s.supplier_id, s.supplier_name ORDER BY products DESC, s.supplier_id LIMIT 5
Total marketing budget by channel: SELECT channel, ROUND(SUM(budget), 2) AS total_budget FROM marketing_campaigns GROUP BY channel ORDER BY total_budget DESC
How many distinct customers placed a com: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS customers FROM orders WHERE year(order_date) = 2024
Total revenue by year: SELECT year(o.order_date) AS year, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100)), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY year ORDER BY year
Total revenue by year, now only for 2024: SELECT year(o.order_date) AS year, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100)), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND year(o.order_date) = 2024 GROUP BY year ORDER BY year
Total revenue by year, now split by chan: SELECT year(o.order_date) AS year, o.channel, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100)), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY year, o.channel ORDER BY year, o.channel
List every product paired with every cus: SELECT p.product_name, c.customer_id FROM products p CROSS JOIN customers c
Show customer emails and phone numbers: SELECT customer_id, email, phone FROM customers ORDER BY customer_id LIMIT 10
